Ava: FYI Aurora provided HW for a perf/W sweep. We want consistent throughput curves and kernel-level tuning comparison. Primary questions: run definitions, power measurement method, and data sharing cadence.
Miguel: I can assemble workload matrix. Plan: conversational long-context (2k tokens batch), batched inference (128 tokens), and a micro-burst test for latency. Will add quantization variants (int8/int4) and batch sizes.
Sanya: I'll manage kernel builds and flamegraph captures. Need exact SKU list and firmware revisions. Also asking for a git tag for the runner so CI is reproducible.
Daniel (Aurora): SKUs: AC-6800-v2, AC-6800-v2-lowpower, AC-5600 for edge parity. Firmware: fw-2026-03-12. We'll share a runner-tag: aurora/bench-runner@v1.4. Telemetry tokens: created `bench-readonly` scoping.
Ava: For power: prefer external PDU CSVs as canonical. We'll also collect PMIC. Add sync pulses in the run so traces align (e.g., `--trace-sync` flag).
Miguel: Noted. I'll add `--trace-sync` to the scripts and generate a canonical run ID per sweep.
Sanya: Kernel to standardize on `5.19.17-rc2-patch-kv`. I'll upload builds to the shared artifact folder once ready.
bench-ci-bot: Dry-run CI job created: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/8421 (dry-run). Results will land in /artifacts/aurora-dryrun/.
Daniel (Aurora): Legal requests a 72-hour review window after data handoff before any public statements. Also asking that both logos be approved before collateral.
Ava: 72h embargo is fine. We'll set internal review 48h post-handoff to prepare messaging. Add embargo note to runbook.
Miguel: I'll schedule the dry-run Fri 10:00 PT, full sweep Mon-Wed next week. Will post prompts and seed lists to the runbook.
Sanya: Uploading kernel builds tonight, will tag artifacts in runbook. Reminder: NTP and hwclock sync before starting runs.
Ava: Run command template in the runbook snippet. Please use the same --telemetry-tag and run-id formats. Next sync Tue 09:30 PT. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
